checks.name: Ranked without a key stays on setup with explanation
Key is refused over remote plaintext WebSocket
One authenticated player enters human-only waiting queue
Waiting beyond connection timeout does not disconnect or start bot match
Eight authenticated humans launch an actual rendered battle
Server independently marks the full-human room ranked

limitations: One headless integrated browser plus seven scripted loopback sockets. Terminal server state is set directly to test persistence/result UI; not a human-completed match, WAN, Steam authentication or minimum-hardware acceptance.
